repos_data.description: Python client for interacting with the Tiingo Financial Data API (stock ticker and news data)

repo_meta_data.description: YQL-finance is a simple and fast Python API https://developer.yahoo.com/yql/console/. The API returns closing prices of stocks for the current period of time and current stock ticker (e.g. APPL, GOOGL). Stock prices: NASDAQ, SP&500, DAX, etc.
